title: Jar Jar Binks
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Jar Jar Binks was the lovable Gungan who helped save the Naboo from the Trade Federation and their Sith allies. Rewarded with the rank of Bombad General, he later traded the swamps of Naboo for the political ones of Coruscant. His unerring loyalty was used against him, and he was manipulated into granting the emergency powers Palpatine used as a stepping stone to create the Empire.
